about: pnpm bench:seek (packages/evals/src/seek-bench.ts): a seek in the preview decoder and the frames after it, in headless Chromium. Milliseconds per request; chunks = calls of VideoDecoder.decode. One machine, one sample of it under whatever load is recorded; not a gate.

948af69..d9b52d8 sample 1.machine: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz ×4, node v22.23.4, load at start 3.47 4.73 5.65, at end 1.93 4.11 5.39
948af69..d9b52d8 sample 1.browser: Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (headless, software decode unless the machine says otherwise)
948af69..d9b52d8 sample 1.fixture: barcode 1280x720, H.264 in MP4, 30 fps, 300 frames, B-frames 2, key frames at most 30 apart: at frames 0, 8, 27, 32, 61, 64, 83, 102, 131, 144, 173, 185, 210, 235, 264, 283
948af69..d9b52d8 sample 1.method: seek targets 45, 130, 14, 89, 263, 59, 172 (13, 28, 6, 6, 28, 27, 28 frames after their key frame), then the next 5 frames; 5 rounds; variants take turns per target. Scrubbing: the same targets one after the other, 5 rounds, variants take turns per round
